The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

The bug: `in_ready` combinationally depended on `out_ready` (`!skid_valid || out_ready`), violating the spec's requirement that it be a function of registered state only — this could cause data to be accepted into a full skid register. Also, when the skid word moved into the output register, `skid_valid` was never cleared, permanently blocking future accepts. Fixed both: `in_ready = !skid_valid`, and `skid_valid <= 1'b0` when the skid word is promoted to the output register.
